(ns build
  (:require [clojure.tools.build.api :as b]))

(def class-dir "target/classes")
(def uber-file "target/kvhttp.jar")
(def basis (delay (b/create-basis {:project "deps.edn"})))

(defn clean [_]
  (b/delete {:path "target"}))

(defn uber [_]
  (clean nil)
  (b/copy-dir {:src-dirs ["src"] :target-dir class-dir})
  (b/compile-clj {:basis @basis
                  :ns-compile '[kvhttp.main]
                  :class-dir class-dir
                  :compile-opts {:direct-linking true
                                 :elide-meta [:doc :file :line :added]}})
  (b/uber {:class-dir class-dir
           :uber-file uber-file
           :basis @basis
           :main 'kvhttp.main}))

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds an AOT-compiled uberjar and a launcher script at ./app.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

clojure -T:build uber

cat > app <<'LAUNCHER'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
exec java -XX:+UseSerialGC -Xshare:auto -jar "$DIR/target/kvhttp.jar" "$@"
LAUNCHER
chmod +x app

(ns kvhttp.handler
  "Ring handler implementing the kvhttp routes."
  (:require [clojure.string :as str]
            [kvhttp.store :as store])
  (:import (java.io ByteArrayOutputStream InputStream)))

(def ^:private key-pattern #"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}")

(def ^:private max-value-bytes (* 1024 1024))

(defn- response
  ([status] (response status ""))
  ([status body] {:status status :headers {} :body body}))

(def ^:private method-not-allowed (response 405))
(def ^:private not-found (response 404))

(defn- read-body ^bytes [body]
  (cond
    (nil? body) (byte-array 0)
    (bytes? body) body
    (string? body) (.getBytes ^String body "UTF-8")
    :else (let [out (ByteArrayOutputStream.)]
            (.transferTo ^InputStream body out)
            (.toByteArray out))))

(defn- keys->json
  "Encodes keys as a JSON array. Keys are validated against `key-pattern`,
  so they never need escaping."
  [ks]
  (str "[" (str/join "," (map #(str \" % \") ks)) "]"))

(defn- health [{:keys [request-method]}]
  (if (= :get request-method)
    (response 200 "ok")
    method-not-allowed))

(defn- list-all [db {:keys [request-method]}]
  (if (= :get request-method)
    {:status 200
     :headers {"Content-Type" "application/json"}
     :body (keys->json (store/list-keys db))}
    method-not-allowed))

(defn- item [db k {:keys [request-method body]}]
  (if-not (re-matches key-pattern k)
    (response 400)
    (case request-method
      :get (if-some [v (store/fetch db k)]
             {:status 200
              :headers {"Content-Type" "application/octet-stream"}
              :body v}
             not-found)
      :put (let [v (read-body body)]
             (if (> (alength v) max-value-bytes)
               (response 413)
               (response (case (store/put! db k v) :created 201 :replaced 200))))
      :delete (if (store/delete! db k) (response 204) not-found)
      method-not-allowed)))

(defn make-handler
  "Returns a Ring handler backed by the store `db`."
  [db]
  (fn [{:keys [uri] :as req}]
    (cond
      (= uri "/health") (health req)
      (= uri "/kv") (list-all db req)
      (str/starts-with? uri "/kv/") (item db (subs uri 4) req)
      :else not-found)))

(ns kvhttp.main
  (:require [kvhttp.handler :as handler]
            [kvhttp.store :as store]
            [org.httpkit.server :as http])
  (:gen-class))

(defn- usage-exit []
  (binding [*out* *err*]
    (println "usage: app <port>"))
  (System/exit 2))

(defn -main [& args]
  (let [port (some-> (first args) parse-long)]
    (when-not (and port (< 0 port 65536))
      (usage-exit))
    (http/run-server (handler/make-handler (store/create))
                     {:ip "127.0.0.1"
                      :port port
                      :thread (max 8 (.availableProcessors (Runtime/getRuntime)))
                      :max-body (* 2 1024 1024)
                      :legacy-return-value? false})))

(ns kvhttp.store
  "Thread-safe in-memory key-value store. Keys are kept sorted so listing
  is a cheap traversal.")

(defn create
  "Returns a new, empty store."
  []
  (atom (sorted-map)))

(defn put!
  "Stores `value` under `k`. Returns :created if the key was new,
  :replaced otherwise."
  [store k value]
  (let [[old _] (swap-vals! store assoc k value)]
    (if (contains? old k) :replaced :created)))

(defn fetch
  "Returns the value stored under `k`, or nil."
  [store k]
  (get @store k))

(defn delete!
  "Removes `k`. Returns true if it was present."
  [store k]
  (let [[old _] (swap-vals! store dissoc k)]
    (contains? old k)))

(defn list-keys
  "Returns all keys in ascending order."
  [store]
  (keys @store))
